appearance_facts.fact: Bold black title reads 'Increasing Clean Grid Output from 2018 to 2023'. This is the only text in the plot area besides axis labels.

appearance_facts.location: plot area, x from ~110 to ~950, y from ~210 to ~280
appearance_facts.fact: A single solid blue line series connects six yearly points. The line starts high at 2018, drops to a local low at 2019, rises to the series maximum at 2020, then steps down to a near-flat level through 2021-2023.
Horizontal axis labeled 'Year' with tick labels 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 spaced left to right.
Vertical axis labeled 'Grid Output (GWh)' with numeric ticks from 0 at the bottom to 2,800 near the top.

2018 point sits at the 2,800 gridline; 2019 point is the lowest visible point just below 2,400; 2020 point is the highest, slightly above 2,800; 2021-2023 points cluster around 2,500-2,600 and are nearly horizontal.
Despite the title's 'Increasing' wording, the line ends (2023) lower than it began (2018) and lower than its 2020 peak; the final three years are flat-to-slightly-declining.

public_definitions: User goal: 'Assess the clean-electricity output dashboard for the 2018-2023 review window and send this record to the operational route that best matches the overall dashboard trend.'
Chart reference: 'Use the dashboard trend as the basis for selecting the appropriate handling path for this output record.'

Option labels: 'Route the record to routine clean-grid output monitoring'; 'Route the record to clean-grid output expansion follow-up'; 'Route the record to clean-grid output decline response review'.
uncertain: The chart title states 'Increasing', but the plotted line shows a 2019 dip, a 2020 peak, and a flat-to-slightly-declining 2021-2023 segment that ends below the 2018 level; the title and the geometry disagree on the overall direction.
Exact GWh values for 2021-2023 are not labeled; readings of ~2,500-2,550 are estimated from gridline position.
No explicit mapping between trend direction (increase/flat/decline) and the three route options is provided in the task text.
